key_insight: A multispectral metasurface paired with a hybrid CNN-ViT model can improve skin lesion detection by capturing both spectral detail and complementary local/global image features.
clinical_relevance: This approach may support faster, more accurate, and potentially portable early skin cancer screening beyond standard RGB dermoscopy.
method: Multispectral metasurface acquires noninvasive spectral information sensitive to tissue changes.
Hybrid CNN-ViT extracts local patterns and global context from lesion images.
Attention maps are used to highlight clinically relevant regions and improve interpretability.
evidence_signal: Simulation-based evaluation reported about 98% accuracy, 95% sensitivity, and 99% specificity, outperforming RGB-based and single-architecture methods in the abstract.
watch_item: The results are simulation-based, so real-world clinical validation and hardware integration are still needed before deployment.
paper_title: Intelligent Skin Cancer Detection Using a Multispectral Metasurface and a Hybrid
